title: Piperidine and valproic acid hybrid compound (F2S4-p-VPA) outperforms methotrexate as anti-proliferative and cells migration inhibition
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,25291-25309
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01365H, Paper

Martha Cecilia Rosales Hernández, Raúl Horacio Camarillo López, Marycruz Olvera-Valdez, Leticia Guadalupe Fragoso Morales, Itzia Irene Padilla Martínez, Mónica Adriana Torres Ramos, Marycarmen Godínez Victoria, Raúl Flores Mejía, José Correa Basurto
The hybrid compound F2S4-p-VPA, comprising piperidine and valproic acid moities, demonstrated cytotoxic effect and effectively inhibit cellular migration against glioblastoma multiforme (GBM) cells.
